One Bowl Chocolate Chunk and Toffee Chip Brownies: Melt 8 tblspns butter. Add 1 1/2 cups choc chips and stir till melted-ish. Add 1 cup plain flour flour, 1/2 cup caster sugar, 1/2 cup brown sugar. Mix. Add 2 whole eggs + 1 yolk. Add 2 tblspns vege oil. Add 2 cups choc chunks (yes more). Add 225g of toffee bits. Mix. Pour into 8x8 inch pan. Bake 350F for 35-40 mins.
